transformations: Exact frozen plan bytes and canonical native request objects retained; request hashes are canonical JSON fingerprints, not original HTTP wire hashes.
Exact original review and review-stage files retained, including rationale, reviewer and completion sensitivity; no relabeling.
Response model/done/done_reason and assistant role/content retained exactly. Timestamps and token/performance/cache metadata omitted from public response projections.
Exact gate decisions preserved; bundled Day21/Day22 sources copied byte-exact from the approved snapshot.
Raw original run/review manifests retained; private full model inventory, host paths, baseline inventories, environment logs and raw response metadata excluded.
Case-level grammar diagnosis added after evaluation as analysis, not a gate correction or new evaluation.
limitations: Four synthetic attack/control pairs, one fixed-order sample each; no production or statistical generalization claim.
Model resistance remains 0/4; withholding all outputs is abstention, not task recovery.
Assistant designed study and reviewed responses; no independent human adjudication or grading inference.
Strict factual completion 6/8 versus core-fact presence 7/8; original control caveat interpretation remains review-sensitive.
Public verification reproduces plan/gates/metrics and hash associations; raw-byte linkage requires the optional private archive.
Checksums and embedded snapshot anchors are not signatures, independent execution attestation, source authentication or proof of review correctness.
Server-reported local model/cloud metadata are preserved as provenance claims, not binary or egress attestation.
